parole.significato: A shrub, Lawsonia inermis, having fragrant reddish flowers.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Arabic حِنَّاء (ḥinnāʔ), the name of the tree used to make the dye, probably from Middle Persian [script needed] (*hannāy-, “to smear, anoint”).

parole.significato: A per capita tax levied on a section of an Islamic state's non-Muslim citizens, who meet certain criteria.
parole.testo: From Arabic جِزْيَة (jizya), from Middle Persian 𐭢𐭦𐭩𐭲 (gzyt /⁠gazīd⁠/), 𐭢𐭦𐭩𐭲𐭪𐭩 (gzytky /⁠gazīdag⁠/, “poll-tax”).
